Message:
What I like,
I want Ayse to like, too...

So, I made her a mud bath.
But, Ayse would not get in...

Still, I did not give up.
I chased her...but Ayse got mad.

She yelled that
she was going to leave...

I do not know why she got mad.
But, I did not want this
to be goodbye.

I want to be with Ayse more.
And, I...

I want to learn,
because I do not know Ayse yet.
That is not a bad thing.
Just like Ayse taught me.

I slowly stuck
my hand out toward Ayse,
and she gently took it.

“I...want to know you, too...
Because...I want to be
your friend, Liberia.”

“Friend”...
Only Gran Gran can
give permission to make friends.
That is the law.
So, breaking it is no good.

But...I...do not want to pretend
I never had these feelings.
Because, I...

Even if breaking the law
was not right,
my heart felt lighter—
far lighter than it ever did
when I followed the law.

After that, me and Ayse
became even better friends.
We fought sometimes,
but we always made up
right away.

I thought we would be
friends forever.

But...breaking the law,
really was no good, after all.
